title: On the optimal shape parameter for kernel methods: Sharp direct and inverse statements
summary: The search for the optimal shape parameter for Radial Basis Function (RBF) kernel approximation has been an outstanding research problem for decades. In this work, we establish a theoretical framework for this problem by leveraging a recently established theory on sharp direct, inverse and saturation statements for kernel based approximation. In particular, we link the search for the optimal shape parameter to superconvergence phenomena.
